generated.as: case when owner_principal_id is null then null else 'user' end
case when accepted_by_principal_id is null then null else 'user' end

provider_configs_name_check.name: provider_configs_name_check
provider_configs_name_check.value:
case when "provider_configs"."kind" = 'openai-compatible'
        then "provider_configs"."name" ~ '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,38}[a-z0-9])?$'
          and "provider_configs"."name" not in ('anthropic', 'openai', 'google')
          and "provider_configs"."base_url" is not null
        else "provider_configs"."name" = "provider_configs"."kind" and "provider_configs"."api_key" is not null end

provider_configs_workspace_scope_check.name: provider_configs_workspace_scope_check
provider_configs_workspace_scope_check.value: "provider_configs"."workspace_id" is null or ("provider_configs"."kind" <> 'openai-compatible' and "provider_configs"."base_url" is null)

usage_default_reason_check.name: usage_default_reason_check
usage_default_reason_check.value:
("usage"."default_reason" is null) = ("usage"."resolution_rule" <> 'default')
        and ("usage"."default_reason" is null or "usage"."default_reason" in
          ('routing_off', 'no_routes', 'too_short', 'classifier_unavailable', 'below_threshold', 'ambiguous'))

conversations_decision_check.name: conversations_decision_check
conversations_decision_check.value:
("conversations"."routed_model" is null) = ("conversations"."route_decided_at" is null)
        and ("conversations"."route_id" is null or "conversations"."routed_model" is not null)

budgets_target_check.name: budgets_target_check
budgets_target_check.value:
("budgets"."scope" = 'instance' and "budgets"."workspace_id" is null and "budgets"."principal_id" is null)
        or ("budgets"."scope" = 'workspace' and "budgets"."workspace_id" is not null and "budgets"."principal_id" is null)
        or ("budgets"."scope" in ('member', 'key') and "budgets"."workspace_id" is not null and "budgets"."principal_id" is not null)

reservations_actual_check.name: reservations_actual_check
reservations_actual_check.value:
("reservations"."state" in ('settled', 'abandoned')) = ("reservations"."actual_micro_usd" is not null)
        and ("reservations"."actual_micro_usd" is null or "reservations"."actual_micro_usd" >= 0)
        and ("reservations"."state" in ('settled', 'abandoned')) = ("reservations"."settled_at" is not null)

mcp_servers_target_check.name: mcp_servers_target_check
mcp_servers_target_check.value:
case when "mcp_servers"."transport" = 'stdio'
        then "mcp_servers"."command" is not null and "mcp_servers"."url" is null and "mcp_servers"."auth_mode" <> 'oauth'
          and ("mcp_servers"."credential_env" is not null) = ("mcp_servers"."auth_mode" = 'shared')
        else "mcp_servers"."url" is not null and "mcp_servers"."command" is null and "mcp_servers"."credential_env" is null
          and "mcp_servers"."args" = '[]'::jsonb end
